card.title: Delegate Downward
card.instruction: Make someone accept an unwanted responsibility by placing them lower in the hierarchy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As junior coordinator, you're responsible for the blocked sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran the whole event yesterday. You said I'd earned a promotion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To senior coordinator. Still below me, but now you can supervise the plumber.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He can only come after everyone leaves.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll lock up too. I can't give building security to a junior.

mechanism: A uses subordinate rank and nominal promotion to assign an unwanted sink problem and its late security consequence.
confusable: Unlike ordinary delegation, the lower place in a hierarchy must justify accepting the burden.
comparison: D53-a turns promotion into more late duties; D53-b uses deputy status to carry replies and representation for A's decisions.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
